target_customer: Solo practitioners and independent professionals in Chile and Mexico (psychologists, doctors, nutritionists, lawyers) who run appointment based practices
problem: Independent professionals manage bookings, reminders, payments and receipts by hand over WhatsApp and phone; Encuadrado bundles scheduling, payments and electronic receipts.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (about $40 per month in 2021) plus payment processing
product_category: Scheduling and payments for independent professionals

founders.name: Tomas Aguilera
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page (engineering and logistics background) and Bloomberg Linea. The idea came from booking problems in his mother's dental practice.

competitors.name: AgendaPro
competitors.what: Chilean online booking software for beauty, health and wellness businesses, incubated by YC
competitors.traction_then: Over 3,700 clients in Latin America as of the January 2022 report
competitors.funding_then: $3.7M round led by Kayyak Ventures reported January 2022 (months after the batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Scheduling, payment integrations and Chilean electronic receipts are standard SaaS and integration work; regulatory certification for clinical records came later.

defensibility.rationale: Booking tools were already common, so the edge was the bundle of payments and receipts and local compliance, which rivals could add.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AgendaPro and Reservo already served the booking use case; no acquisition or copying of Encuadrado was found.

market_need_then: The founders cited 27.2 percent of the Chilean workforce as self employed, many still managing bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram or phone calls (Bloomberg Linea, Nov 2021).

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language, tagline about managing the practice so the professional can attend patients

brand_strength.rationale: The name resembles the Spanish therapy term encuadre, but no source confirms it, and no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Encuadrado launched in Chile in 2019, expanded to Mexico in 2021, joined YC in Summer 2021 and raised a $1.5M seed in November 2021. Forbes Chile reported about 1,500 active professionals in 2022. It has focused on health professionals with certified clinical records and appears active, but no later round was found and the scale remains small against AgendaPro.
notes: A $125K pre seed in August 2021 appears only on Seedtable, so it is unverified. CB Insights shows $130K total and Extruct $2M; both conflict and are not used. Bloomberg Linea says total raised about $1.625M. The Bloomberg Linea piece names Square as the model, not a direct competitor. AgendaPro comparison source is dated about seven months after the batch because no earlier dated source was found.
